property_summary: For any user with balance B, calling withdrawBalance() must never make the contract send out more than B total, even if the recipient re-enters once during the external call; the mutant zeroes the balance after the call, so the re-entrant callback sees the stale balance and extracts an extra withdrawal.
change_summary: Move the balance zeroing to after the external call, enabling a reentrant withdraw to see the original balance.
